purpose: An independent oracle for the Alberta builder. Rules are generated from the online edition of the 2026 Alberta Guide to Hunting Regulations; this compares every generated row against the government-hosted PDF of the same guide, so a parsing error or a divergence between the two channels shows up as a disagreement instead of as a confident answer. It is never used to produce a rule.
